title: Complete Travel Guide to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar in 2026
content:
Welcome to Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar

Discover the rich heritage and vibrant culture of Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, formerly known as Aurangabad. This comprehensive guide will help you explore the best attractions, hotels, and experiences in this historic city.

Top Attractions

  • Ajanta Caves - UNESCO World Heritage Site with ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves
  • Ellora Caves - Magnificent rock-cut temples representing three religions
  • Bibi Ka Maqbara - The "Taj of the Deccan" built in 1660
  • Daulatabad Fort - Historic hilltop fortress with stunning architecture

Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to visit Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar is between October and March when the weather is pleasant and perfect for sightseeing.

Local Cuisine

Don't miss trying the local Maharashtrian delicacies including Naan Khaliya, Tahri, and the famous Himroo shawls as souvenirs.

Getting Around

The city is well-connected by road, rail, and air. Local transportation includes auto-rickshaws, taxis, and rental cars available through CSNExplore.
